---
title: "Metabolomics preprocessing"
author: "Homa Bazireh"
output: html_document
---

This executable core is extracted from the original notebook with the same
filename. It selects the identifier and metabolite columns from the provider's
already normalized, imputed, log-transformed and standardized P500 export.
Authorized exclusions are supplied in a private configuration file rather than
embedded sample row numbers. The input order must match the reviewed export.

Run from the repository root using `scripts/run_analysis.R`, or run
`Rscript scripts/preprocess_omics.R metabolomics`. See `docs/preprocessing.md`
for the distinction between the original diagnostic IQR replacement and its
exported matrix. No extra log/z transformation or new missing-value imputation
is performed here.

```{r preprocessing}
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("KORA_CODE_DIR"), "scripts", "preprocess_omics.R"))
run_preprocessing("metabolomics")
```

Private outputs are `processed/Scaled.log.Trans.Metabolomics.RData` and
`processed/Scaled.log.Trans.Metabolomics.csv`. The RData object is named
`Scaled.log.Trans.Metabolomics`. Participant-level plots remain private.
